verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents its own REST API covering client listing and details, session history, closing sessions, session comments and alias changes, plus a Python helper module. It also documents a CLI for install, configuration, connection and removal. However, the evidence shows portal features with no API equivalent, such as address book management, user, role and permission administration, and custom client configuration, so UI parity is far from established. Missing for 10: API coverage of address books, users/roles/permissions and custom clients; a published OpenAPI spec (probes 404); any explicit API-to-UI parity claim; independent corroboration.
